column1: # Original DICE Crossfire, play time 1180 kOhm (default; N9 ends a game after about
# 129.6 s). Fire in attract (300, 500 ms) does not start a game; the coin at 1000 ms
# starts one (no Start switch). The left stick alone holds Up to its clamp and Down
# under the bottom border (2000-5000 ms), then the right stick (5000-8000 ms); both
# guns return up. Left Fire held 2 s fires once; a second press during the flight is
# ignored; a later press fires again (9000-12550 ms); the same for the right gun
# (13000-16550 ms). Recorded closed-loop play (17000-115000 ms): left gun alone,
# right gun alone and both, so both players hit the ball and score. A coin at
# 60000 ms changes nothing; the game ends at the timer; Fire after the end does not
# start a game; a coin at 135000 ms restarts with cleared scores and the right gun
# scores again. Rows: ms action value (upN/downN/buttonS1 held switches).
